salt_pct.quote: Samsoe cheese is a semi-hard pressed Danish cheese with few round holes, contains on average 1.8% (w/w) NaCl (g/100 g cheese), maximum 52% moisture in the type with 30% fat in dry matter (30 +) and is ripened in plastic bags.

compounds.quote: main products of citrate fermentation are diacetyl, acetic acid and CO2 . Diacetyl was recorded in UMB1 cheese in the amount of 0.1853 ppm with maximum value of 2.477 ppm in Samsø and minimum of 0.0526 ppm in Terroir.
compounds.name: diacetyl

ammonia.reason: Long proteolysis and deamination of amino acids raises pH to 5.99 with low NH3 in film-ripened paste.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and DL starter give very low p-cresol/indole from tryptophan.

bitter.reason: Accumulated hydrophobic peptides from rennet/chymosin with balanced Lactococcus peptidase debittering.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no methyl ketone blue pathway.

browning.reason: Moderate residual galactose/lactose plus lysine for Maillard on heating of aged semi-hard paste.

buttery.reason: Very high diacetyl 2.477 ppm from citrate fermentation by Leuconostoc/lactis biovar diacetylactis.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipolysis by starter esterases yielding low butyric/hexanoic acids, no added lipase.

creaminess.reason: 42.5% moisture and 29% fat (~50% FDM) with cooked pressed paste giving smooth fat-coated mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic pressed curd with round CO2 eyes and calcium solubilization, not friable.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard moisture 42.5% and 18-mo proteolysis giving firm but sliceable body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by lactococci.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from starter esterase esterification of acids with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat lacks high 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic goaty branched acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine/isoleucine Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal plus aged amino-acid nutty notes.

melt.reason: Rennet curd pH ~5.4-5.99 with demineralized paracasein flows on heating, not acid-set.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Film ripening prevents mold 1-octen-3-ol; trace from surface flora only in aged sample.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil from ~50% FDM coalesced fat on melting, not high-fat oiling.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/syringol phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid plus acetic acid from citrate/heterofermentation by DL culture, buffered by high pH.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet gel without hot-water stretching, so no aligned paracasein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Light cooking/scalding gives low H2S/methional/dimethyl sulfide, no surface sulfur flora.

sweet.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin sweetness plus proline/glycerol masking low residual acidity.

umami.reason: Glutamate release from extended casein proteolysis by rennet and starter peptidases.
